selection_reason: Fixed panel of known ATP-site ABL1 inhibitors, selected for target relevance without inspecting panel DILI predictions.
ranking_rule: Descending arithmetic mean of all returned affinity_probability_binary values; compound_id ascending breaks exact ties; top two successful scored candidates shortlisted.
claims: Retrospective workflow illustration. Report DILI training/validation membership; do not claim unseen-drug validation. Do not change panel or thresholds to manufacture a priority change.
